spec_improvements: Offer a variant with drainage holes and a plug, and clearly label the standard version as a cachepot with no drainage.
Use a loose-fit or easy twist-off saucer instead of an attached one, and test that it comes off easily before shipping.
Add a sealed lacquer coating and a finish quality check so the hammered gold does not wear away.
Wrap each planter and saucer separately in soft padding so the gold finish is not scratched in transit.
